GIG HARBOR, WA / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / IP Strategy Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq:IPST) (the "Company" or "IP Strategy") today announced that it received a notification letter from The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC ("Nasdaq") dated November 24, 2026, advising the Company that, because it has not yet filed its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the period ended September 30, 2026 (the "Form 10-Q"), the Company is not currently in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1).

Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) requires listed companies to timely file all required periodic financial reports with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

The Nasdaq notification has no immediate effect on the listing of the Company's common stock on Nasdaq. However, if the Company fails to timely regain compliance with the Listing Rule 5250(c)(1), the Company's common stock will be subject to delisting from Nasdaq.

Under the Nasdaq Listing Rules, the Company has 60 calendar days from the date of the notification, or until January 23, 2027, to submit to Nasdaq a plan to regain compliance. If Nasdaq accepts the Company's plan, Nasdaq may grant the Company an exception of up to 180 calendar days from the original due date of the Form 10-Q, or until May 24, 2027, to regain compliance. If Nasdaq does not accept the Company's plan, then the Company will have the opportunity to appeal that decision to a Nasdaq Hearings Panel.

The Company is diligently working to complete and file the Form 10-Q and intends to take the necessary steps to regain compliance with Nasdaq's continued listing requirements in December 2026.

About IP Strategy

IP Strategy Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: IPST) is the first Nasdaq-listed company to hold $DATA tokens, formerly $IP, as a primary treasury reserve asset and operate validator infrastructure for the DATA Network. The Company provides public market investors broad exposure to the AI-native data economy through a regulated equity vehicle. IP Strategy's treasury reserve enables direct participation in the DATA ecosystem, which supports the sourcing, verification, provenance and auditability of real-world data while enabling trusted attribution and commercialization of digital assets and AI training data.

WASHINGTON, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- 60 Degree Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: SXTP; SXTPW) (“60 Degrees Pharma” or the “Company”), a pharmaceutical company focused on developing new medicines for vector-borne disease, today announced that it will effect a one-for-seven (1:7) reverse stock split (the "reverse split") of its common stock, par value $0.0001 per share (the "Common Stock"), that will become effective on December 2, 2026, at 12:01 AM Eastern Time, before the opening of trading on The Nasdaq Capital Market ("Nasdaq"). 60 Degrees Pharma has requested that its Common Stock begin trading on December 2, 2026, on a post-reverse split basis on the Nasdaq under the existing symbol "SXTP".

The reverse split is primarily intended to bring 60 Degrees Pharma into compliance with the minimum bid price requirement for maintaining its listing on the Nasdaq. The new CUSIP number for the Common Stock following the reverse split will be 83006G609.

At 60 Degree Pharma’s special meeting of stockholders on August 5, 2026 (the "Special Meeting"), 60 Degree Pharma’s stockholders approved the proposal to authorize 60 Degree Pharma’s board of directors (the "Board"), in its sole and absolute discretion, to file a certificate of amendment (the "Amendment") to 60 Degree Pharma’s amended and restated certificate of incorporation to effect the reverse split of the Company at a ratio of one-to-seven (1:7). On November 12, 2026, the Board approved the reverse split at a ratio of one-to-seven (1:7), and the Amendment has been filed with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware, which will become effective on November 30, 2026, at 12:01 AM Eastern Time, before the opening of trading on the Nasdaq.

The reverse split will affect all issued and outstanding shares of Common Stock. All outstanding options, restricted stock awards, warrants and other securities entitling their holders to purchase or otherwise receive shares of Common Stock will be adjusted as a result of the reverse split, as required by the terms of each security. The number of shares available to be awarded under any Equity Incentive Plan will also be appropriately adjusted. Following the reverse split, the par value of the Common Stock will remain unchanged at $0.0001 per share. The reverse split will not change the authorized number of shares of Common Stock or preferred stock. No fractional shares of Common Stock shall be issued as a result of the Reverse Split, and stockholders who otherwise would be entitled to receive fractional shares of New Common Stock shall be entitled to receive the number of shares of New Common Stock rounded up to the next whole number. The reverse split will affect all stockholders uniformly and will not alter any stockholder's percentage interest in 60 Degree Pharma’s equity (other than as a result of the rounding of fractional shares, as set forth above).

The reverse split will reduce the number of shares of Common Stock issued and outstanding from approximately 4,484,622 to approximately 560,578.

About 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals, Inc.

60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals, Inc., founded in 2010, specializes in developing and commercializing new medicines for the treatment and prevention of vector-borne disease. The Company achieved U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval of its lead product, ARAKODA® (tafenoquine), for malaria prevention in 2018. ARAKODA is commercially available in the U.S. and Australia. 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals, Inc. also collaborates with prominent research and academic organizations in the U.S. and Australia. 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is headquartered in Washington, D.C., with a subsidiary in Australia. Winnipeg, Manitoba--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Frontier Nuclear and Minerals Inc. (NASDAQ: FNUC) ("Frontier"), a nuclear fuel cycle company, announces that on November 25, 2026, it received a written notification letter (the "Notification Letter") from the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC ("Nasdaq"), notifying Frontier that it was not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), as the minimum bid price of Frontier's common shares ("Shares") has been below US $1.00 per share for 30 consecutive business days.

The Notification Letter is only a notification of deficiency and not a notice of delisting. As such, the Notification Letter has no immediate effect on the listing or trading of Frontier's Shares on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol "FNUC."

Nasdaq Listing Rules

Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) requires securities listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market to maintain a minimum bid price of US$1.00 per share, and Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(A) provides that a failure to meet the minimum bid price requirement exists if the deficiency continues for a period of 30 consecutive business days. Based on the closing bid price of Frontier's Shares for the 30 consecutive business days from October 14, 2026 to November 24, 2026, Frontier has not met the minimum bid price requirement.

In accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(A), Frontier has a period of 180 calendar days, or until May 24, 2027 in which to regain compliance with the minimum bid price requirement. To regain compliance, the closing bid price of the Frontier's Shares must meet or exceed US $1.00 for at least ten consecutive business days during this 180-calendar day period. In the event Frontier does not regain compliance by May 24, 2027, Frontier may be eligible for an additional 180 calendar day grace period if it meets the continued listing requirement for market value of publicly held shares (US $1 million) and all other initial listing standards for The Nasdaq Capital Market, with the exception of the bid price and provides written notice to Nasdaq of its intention to cure the deficiency during the second compliance period, by effecting a reverse stock split, if necessary. If it appears to Nasdaq that Frontier will not be able to cure the deficiency, or if Frontier is not otherwise eligible for additional time to regain compliance, Frontier's Shares will be subject to delisting by Nasdaq. Frontier may still appeal Nasdaq's determination to delist its Shares, and during any appeal process, Frontier's Shares would continue to trade on the Nasdaq Capital Market.

Frontier is issuing this press release pursuant to Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(b). Nasdaq advised Frontier that it will be added to Nasdaq's public list of non-compliant companies beginning five business days after the date of the notice. Nasdaq will also distribute a non-compliance indicator through its market data network and make it available to third-party market data providers.

Frontier's management intends to actively monitor the bid price for its Shares and will consider all available options to regain compliance with the Nasdaq minimum bid price requirement.

Frontier's business operations are not affected by the receipt of the Notification Letter.

About Frontier Nuclear and Minerals Inc.

Frontier Nuclear and Minerals Inc. is focused on building a U.S.-based nuclear fuel cycle platform through uranium exploration and development assets, together with targeted investments in Ubaryon Pty. Ltd., a private Australian company developing next generation enrichment technology, and Kadmos Energy Services LLC, a private U.S. company developing small modular light water reactors. Frontier continues to evaluate opportunities in the nuclear fuel cycle that align with its long-term strategic objectives.

Brisbane, Australia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Adyton Resources Corporation (TSXV: ADY) (OTCQB: ADYRF) (FSE: 701) ("Adyton" or the "Company") announces that it has filed its financial statements for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and accompanying Management Discussion and Analysis on its SEDAR+ profile at www.sedarplus.ca.

KEY HIGHLIGHTS

  • Fiscal discipline and strong quarter-end cash position:
    The Company maintained a disciplined approach to capital allocation throughout the year, ensuring efficient deployment of funds across exploration programs. As a result, the Company ended the period with a combined cash and cash equivalents and other financial assets (Term Deposits) of $11.2 million at September 30, 2026, providing a strong foundation for planned activities in the upcoming period.
  • Mining lease granted for Fergusson Wapolu project:
    On November 17, 2026, the Company received formal notification that the Mineral Resources Authority in Papua New Guinea granted Mining Lease ML 1390 ("ML") and Lease for Mining Purposes LMP ("LMP") 152 to Fergusson Wapolu Limited in respect of the Wapolu Gold Project on Fergusson Island.

    ML 1390 covers an area of approximately 845.54 hectares and has a term of 20 years, while LMP 152 covers approximately 95.40 hectares and has a term of five years. Both tenements are effective November 12, 2026.

    The granting of these tenements represents a major regulatory milestone in the Company's strategy to advance the Wapolu Gold Project toward commercial production. The Mining Lease provides the principal mineral tenure required for mining activities, while the Lease for Mining Purposes supports associated mining infrastructure and development activities, subject to applicable conditions and regulatory requirements.

    The Company is progressing the administrative requirements associated with the grants and will continue to advance processing plant commissioning, mine development planning and other operational preparations.

    Although the grants represent a significant step toward the recommencement of mining operations at Wapolu, the timing of commercial production remains subject to the satisfaction of applicable regulatory conditions, completion of commissioning and other operational requirements.
  • Adyton commences trading on the Papua New Guinea Stock Exchange:
    The Company commenced trading on the Papua New Guinea Stock Exchange, under the symbol "ADY", complementing its primary listing on the TSX Venture Exchange in Canada and providing Papua New Guinean investors with a direct domestic market through which to gain exposure to the Company and its portfolio of gold and copper-gold projects in Papua New Guinea.
  • Updated Mineral Resource Estimate for the Fergusson Gameta Project:
    As indicated in the previous quarter, the Company reported an updated NI 43 101 Mineral Resource Estimate (MRE) for its Gameta Gold Project ("Gameta") on Fergusson Island, Papua New Guinea (PNG).

    The updated Gameta MRE incorporates approximately 4,000 metres of infill drilling completed in 2025 and comprises an indicated mineral resource of 8.94 million tonnes grading 1.41g/t Au containing 404,000 ounces of gold and an inferred mineral resource of 6.52 million tonnes grading 0.99g/t Au containing 207,000 ounces of gold. The proposed acquisition would deepen business banking expertise and expand Peak's reach into Arizona and New Mexico

EUGENE, Ore. and LACEY, Wash. and SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Peak Credit Union announced today that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire all assets and assume all liabilities of Southwest Heritage Bank, a subsidiary of Bancorp 34, Inc. (OTC: BCTF), in an all-cash transaction.

The proposed acquisition would bring together Peak's broad consumer financial services and member-owned cooperative model with Southwest Heritage's commercial lending expertise, treasury management services, and established business relationships across Arizona and New Mexico. The combination is intended to expand the financial resources available to individuals and business owners while preserving the local expertise and personal relationships valued by Southwest Heritage customers.

"Our focus is on finding meaningful ways to serve more people," said Dr. David L. Tuyo II, president and CEO of Peak Credit Union. "We know many of our members already spend part of the year in Arizona, making it a natural place for us to grow. Southwest Heritage has built trusted relationships with local businesses, backed by people who understand their communities. Bringing that expertise together with Peak's broader capabilities gives us an opportunity to help more people and businesses move toward their financial goals."

Over time, Peak members could benefit from deeper commercial lending and treasury management capabilities, while Southwest Heritage customers could gain access to additional consumer financial services. Specific products, eligibility, and timing will be determined as integration planning progresses.

The employees and relationships of Southwest Heritage Bank are central to the value of the planned transition. Peak intends to retain Southwest Heritage employees at closing, subject to ordinary business and individual circumstances, to support service continuity and integration. Peak also intends to retain members of Southwest Heritage's executive leadership team in senior roles. Final roles and reporting relationships remain subject to approval and integration planning.

There are no immediate changes to branch operations, accounts, or banking services as a result of today's announcement. Until the transaction closes, the two organizations are expected to continue to operate independently, and members and customers do not need to take any action. It is expected that Peak will communicate any future changes directly and in advance.

The boards of directors of Peak Credit Union, Southwest Heritage Bank and Bancorp 34, Inc. approved the agreement unanimously. The transaction remains subject to customary regulatory and shareholder approvals and is expected to close in the second half of 2027.

Following closing, Southwest Heritage Bank and Bancorp 34, Inc. is expected to dissolve and distribute the remaining assets of Bancorp 34, Inc. to its shareholders in accordance with the transaction terms.

D.A. Davidson & Co. served as financial advisor and Otteson Shapiro LLP served as legal counsel to Southwest Heritage Bank and Bancorp 34, Inc. McQueen Financial Advisors served as financial advisor and Luse Gorman, PC served as legal counsel to Peak Credit Union.

About Peak Credit Union: Peak Credit Union is a member-owned, not-for-profit financial cooperative serving more than 250,000 members through 35 branches across Washington and Oregon and digital banking services. Formed from the combination of TwinStar Credit Union and Northwest Community Credit Union, Peak brings a longstanding commitment to financial education, accessible financial services and community well-being. Through the PeakCU Foundation, Peak supports local initiatives including classroom grants, scholarships and financial education. Federally insured by NCUA. Equal Housing Opportunity. Learn more at peakcu.org.

The bank offers commercial lending, treasury management and personal financial services, with an emphasis on local relationships and responsive service. Southwest Heritage Bank is a subsidiary of Bancorp 34, Inc. (OTC: BCTF). Member FDIC. Learn more at swhbank.com.

BROOKFIELD, NEWS, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P. (“BEP”) (NYSE: BEP; TSX: BEP.UN) today announced updates to the plan of arrangement to advance the proposed corporate simplification (the “Simplification”) and declared its quarterly distribution.

In light of the expected benefits of the Simplification to all unitholders and approximately 62% of units voted to date with 99.7% of votes cast in favour, the BEP limited partnership agreement (“LPA”) and plan of arrangement were amended to facilitate completion of the Simplification. 

The amended plan of arrangement now requires approval by two-thirds of votes cast by Unitholders rather than approval by holders of two-thirds of all eligible units. Unitholders will no longer be required to vote on amendments to the BEP LPA and all other substantive terms of the plan of arrangement, including the tax implications and expected benefits for investors, have been retained.

Unitholders who have already submitted a proxy or voting instruction form do not need to vote again.

The deadline for registered unitholders to cast their votes by proxy will now be 5:00 p.m. (Toronto time) on December 7, 2026 with the Unitholders’ Meeting being held virtually on December 9, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. (Toronto time).

The quarterly distribution for BEP will be paid on December 21, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business on December 8, 2026, and it is expected that the Simplification will be completed by the end of 2026.

Corporate Simplification Details

Following an amendment to the BEP limited partnership agreement, the Simplification will now be completed pursuant to the terms of an amended plan of arrangement (the “Arrangement”). Upon receipt of approval from BEP unitholders of the Simplification, all outstanding limited partnership units of BEP, other than preferred units, will, together with certain related exchangeable securities, be exchanged on a one-for-one basis for newly issued shares of Brookfield Renewable Partners Inc. (“BEP Inc.”).

Shareholders of Brookfield Renewable Corporation (“BEPC”) have already approved the Simplification, pursuant to which their class A exchangeable subordinate voting shares will be exchanged for new shares of BEP Inc. on a one-for-one basis.

Benefits of a Simplified Structure

Brookfield Renewable expects the Simplification to be tax-deferred for Canadian and U.S. investors and completed without any meaningful cost to the business, while providing securityholders with the following benefits, among others:

  • Improved consolidated trading liquidity through a single listed security;
  • Increased demand from current indices and potential additional index inclusion;
  • Stronger alignment with long-term capital allocation trends toward indexable and ETF-eligible corporate securities;
  • Simplified investor analysis, screening, and benchmarking through a single listed reporting entity;
  • Broader access to a larger pool of investors who prefer corporate structures;
  • Enhanced governance framework and voting rights for public securityholders; and
  • For BEP unitholders, elimination of onerous partnership tax reporting forms and preferential dividend tax rates for many Canadian and U.S. taxable investors.

The Simplification will be implemented by way of a court-approved plan of arrangement and will be subject to customary regulatory approvals for a transaction of this nature, including approval for the listing of BEP Inc.’s shares on the New York Stock Exchange and Toronto Stock Exchange.

There will be no change to Brookfield’s ownership of Brookfield Renewable as a result of the Simplification. BEP’s preferred units and public debt will remain outstanding and unaffected by the Simplification.

The Board of Directors of BEP, based in part on the unanimous recommendation of its nominating and governance committee (consisting entirely of independent directors) and the fairness opinion previously received from Scotiabank, unanimously affirmed the conclusion that the Simplification, as amended, is in the best interests of BEP, and have unanimously resolved to approve the Simplification and recommend that BEP unitholders vote in favour of the Simplification.

Torys LLP is acting as legal advisor to Brookfield Renewable for the Simplification.

Scotiabank is acting as independent financial advisor, and Goodmans LLP is acting as independent legal counsel to the nominating and governance committees of each of BEP and BEPC in connection with the Simplification.

Further information regarding the Simplification, including details on the vote that will be required, will be contained in a disclosure supplement that will be available later today. Copies of the supplement, the arrangement agreement amendment, the amended plan of arrangement and certain related documents will be filed with the applicable Canadian securities regulators and with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission and will be available on SEDAR+ at https://sedarplus.ca and on EDGAR at https://sec.gov.

BEP Unitholders Who Have Questions or Require Voting Assistance

Brookfield Renewable has retained Laurel Hill Advisory Group (“Laurel Hill”) as its proxy solicitation agent. If you have any questions about the Unitholders’ Meeting or require assistance voting, please contact Laurel Hill:

Brookfield Renewable may also use the services of Broadridge Investor Communications to assist eligible beneficial unitholders with voting their units over the telephone with Laurel Hill. Many unitholders are eligible to vote quickly and easily over the phone, via email, or text message to help achieve the Simplification.

Please note that BEP has applied for exemptive relief from the Ontario Securities Commission in order to not require further approval by the holders of class A shares of Brookfield Renewable Partners Inc. (“BEP Inc. Class A Shares”) for any future distributions of BEP Inc. Class A Shares or securities that are, directly or indirectly, convertible into, or exercisable or exchangeable for, BEP Inc. Class A Shares under a prospectus, conditional upon obtaining the required securityholder approvals described in the joint management information circular (as supplemented). Accordingly, (i) in respect of BEPC, a vote in favour of the Simplification by BEPC shareholders constituted a vote in favour of BEP Inc.’s ability to conduct future issuances of BEP Inc. Class A Shares or securities that are, directly or indirectly, convertible into, or exercisable or exchangeable for, BEP Inc. Class A Shares pursuant to a prospectus, and (ii) in respect of BEP, a vote in favour of the Simplification by BEP unitholders will constitute a vote in favour of BEP Inc.’s ability to conduct future issuances of BEP Inc. Class A Shares or securities that are, directly or indirectly, convertible into, or exercisable or exchangeable for, BEP Inc. Class A Shares pursuant to a prospectus, in each case, without requiring further approval by holders of BEP Inc. Class A Shares in accordance with National Instrument 41-101 – General Prospectus Requirements.

Distribution Declaration and Update on Distribution Reinvestment Plan

The Q4 2026 quarterly distribution by BEP in the amount of $0.392 per LP unit will be payable on December 21, 2026 to unitholders of record as at the close of business on December 8, 2026. In conjunction with BEP’s distribution declaration, the Board of Directors of BEPC has declared an equivalent dividend of $0.392 per BEPC share, also payable on December 21, 2026 to shareholders of record as at the close of business on December 8, 2026. It is expected that the Simplification will be completed in December 2026, following the payment of distributions and dividends on December 21, 2026.

As a result of the expected timing of completion of the Simplification, BEP’s distribution reinvestment plan will be terminated effective November 27, 2026. The final distribution of BEP units under the plan was made in respect of BEP’s distribution paid on September 29, 2026 to unitholders of record as of August 31, 2026. Participants will receive the December 21, 2026 distribution in cash.

BEP Inc. expects to adopt a dividend reinvestment plan for the BEP Inc. Class A Shares that is substantially similar to BEP’s plan. Registered unitholders who currently participate in BEP’s distribution reinvestment plan will be required to confirm their enrolment in the BEP Inc. plan by June 21, 2027, and non-registered holders should contact their broker or other intermediary.

About Brookfield Renewable

Brookfield Renewable operates one of the world’s largest publicly traded platforms for renewable power and sustainable solutions. Our renewable power portfolio consists of hydroelectric, wind, utility-scale solar, distributed solar and storage facilities and our sustainable solutions assets include our investment in a leading global nuclear services business and a portfolio of investments in carbon capture and storage capacity, agricultural renewable natural gas, materials recycling and eFuels manufacturing capacity, among others.

A Major Mining Company Sole Funding a Minimum Two-Year Exploration Alliance Under September Term Sheet

Three New Licenses Expected in Early 2027, Vardenis Option Ended to Remove Carrying Costs

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Hayasa Metals Inc. (TSXV: HAY) (OTCQB: HAYAF) ("Hayasa" or the "Company") reports geochemical and assay results from two diamond drill holes totaling 1,052.9 meters ("m") from the western zone of the Company's Urasar Project in northern Armenia.

2026 Drilling Highlights

  • Both holes intersected strong to intense hydrothermal alteration and stockwork veining, consistent with the upper levels of a porphyry-style system.

  • Copper and gold grades were low; mineralized core of the system has not yet been intersected.

  • Hayasa controls 100% of Urasar; seeks a partner for the next phase.

Diamond drill hole UDD-022 tested the Oxide Basin prospect and returned 21.0 m grading 0.08% copper ("Cu") and 0.12 g/t gold ("Au") from 321 to 342 m depth, including 4.0 m with 0.33% Cu and 0.35 g/t Au.

The 21 m elevated gold interval occurs within a longer anomalous interval of 124 m averaging 0.04% Cu and 0.035 g/t Au from 256 to 380 m. The highest individual copper and gold sample in this program returned 0.5% Cu and 0.4 g/t Au from 338 to 340 m.

Hole UDD-023 tested the Silica West zone and returned narrower intervals of elevated copper, including 1.2 m grading 0.2% Cu from 330.8 to 332.0 m. A separate 8.0 m interval from 366 to 374 m averaged 0.05% Cu, and a single 1.6 m sample from 116.3 m returned 19.6 g/t silver ("Ag"). Both holes intersected strong to intense hydrothermal alteration and stockwork veining.

Intervals are downhole lengths. True widths are unknown. Composite grades are weighted by sample length using all samples within each stated interval. The 124.0 m interval describes a broad sampled section, with no grade cutoff applied.

2026 Drilling and Geological Interpretation

This recent drill program tested steeply oriented low-resistivity targets identified on two Audio Magneto Telluric (AMT) profiles at the western end of the Urasar license. Final collar records confirm a combined depth of 1,052.9 m, which is revised from the 1,070 m reported on September 4, 2026. The drill hole targeting was based on the May 2026 six-line, 53-station AMT survey, surface geochemistry and mapped alteration, as well as an earlier 39 m drill intercept averaging 0.50% Cu and 0.18 ppm Au intersected in Hole UDD-021 in Oxide Basin. The two-hole 2026 drill program returned lower copper values than UDD-021 over the broader intervals reported here. These weakly mineralized intervals are hosted in similar brecciated and altered lithologies as intersected in UDD-021.

Both holes intersected multiphase quartz-anhydrite veining with ubiquitous pyrite accessory chalcopyrite, and occasional enargite in strong to intense argillic to advanced argillic alteration. Potassic alteration was observed at depth. These characteristics are consistent with the upper levels of a porphyry-style hydrothermal system.

Oxide Basin UDD-022

UDD-022 was completed to 622.0 m and encountered intense silicification from 170.1 to 254.6 m, followed by predominantly propylitic alteration with local silicification and repeated stockwork intervals. The strongest copper and gold values fall within a fault zone from 335.4 to 343.5 m, in a porphyritic unit. Farther downhole, stockwork veining was intersected from 390.0 to 457.6 m and from 483.0 to 503.0 m.

Silica West UDD-023

UDD-023 was completed to 430.9 m. The hole intersected shallow argillic and sericitic alteration, silicification from 44.2 to 224.9 m, and predominantly propylitic alteration from 224.9 m to the end of the hole. Stockwork veining was encountered from 141.0 to 236.1 m and from 264.8 to 430.9 m (end of hole). The higher copper assays occur as short intervals within this lower altered sequence.

Management Comments

Hovo Karapetyan, Chief Geologist and Country Manager, commented: "The pervasive strong to intense alteration, extensive brecciation and widespread sulfide mineralization encountered to date indicate that we are operating within a large and strongly developed hydrothermal system. While our exploration program has completed 23 holes totaling over 5,000 meters, we have yet to intersect the mineralized core of the system. However, the widespread presence of anomalous, albeit low-grade, gold, base metal and arsenic values indicate that we are exploring in the right geological environment. Further analysis of the extensive Hayasa exploration database, together with historical Soviet-era data, is underway to refine our geological understanding and better vector future exploration towards the mineralized core of the system."

Hayasa CEO, Joel Sutherland, adds: "We have now drilled more than 5,000 m at Urasar. These two holes returned lower grades than we were looking for, but the drill core still indicates a system whose center we have yet to find. There is a decent amount of inbound interest on Urasar, the property is 34 km2 and there are additional zones to explore. We will announce our plans on Urasar in early 2027."

Sampling and Analytical Quality Control

Hayasa's local geological team split and sampled the drill core in Armenia. Samples were prepared at the accredited Institute of Mining and Metallurgy in Armenia and analyzed by ALS in Romania, where the laboratory operates to international standards. The 2026 assay workbook lists 590 downhole sample intervals and records ALS methods Au-AA23 (30 g fire assay with an atomic absorption finish for gold) and ME-ICP61 (four-acid digestion with an ICP-AES finish for multi-element analysis).

Hayasa inserted one QA/QC control sample every 20 m of drilling. The control samples comprised standards, duplicates and blanks.

Portfolio Focus and Termination of Vardenis Option

The Company has elected to terminate its option with Mendia Resources on the Vardenis property in central Armenia after the withdrawal of our former partner. This removes the carrying costs of the property and lets the Company concentrate on its strategic exploration alliance with a major mining company in southern Armenia and on the three new exploration licenses it expects to receive in early 2027.

As announced on September 21, 2026, Hayasa signed a term sheet with a major mining company for a strategic exploration alliance focused on copper and other critical metals in southern Armenia. Under the term sheet, the alliance phase has a term of two years and is solely funded by the major mining company. After US$1,000,000 has been spent within the alliance area of interest, the major mining company may earn a 51% interest in a designated project by funding US$1,000,000 on that project over two years, and may increase its interest to 70% by funding a further US$3,000,000 over three years. Hayasa is the operator during the first option period. The term sheet is non-binding except for certain limited provisions, and the alliance remains subject to the negotiation and execution of definitive agreements, which are expected before year end.

As previously announced (see news releases dated April 2 and May 11, 2026), the three license applications are Amasia in northern Armenia, an antimony-nickel-cobalt prospect, Hovo's Reward and Mount Stephanie in central Armenia, which host copper-silver and copper-gold surface anomalies, respectively.

Mr. Sutherland, adds: "Vardenis did a lot for Hayasa Metals and we arguably would not be in a strategic alliance without the work we performed there. We completed robust geophysics and drilled over 5,000 m and worked with an exceptional team of drillers and geologists. We have a lot going on in 2027 with the strategic alliance activity accelerating and the addition of three new exploration licenses."

(“Hi-View” or the “Company”) (CSE: GXLD; OTCQB: GXLDF; FSE: B630) announces that the Company has been subject to a social engineering cyberattack by a sophisticated third party that resulted in a wire transfer of the Company’s funds to a fraudulent third-party account. The crime resulted in the misappropriation of $1,564,777.05.

Upon learning of the incident, the Company took steps to secure its systems and mitigate the impact on the Company’s data and operations. At this time, the Company is not aware of any evidence that any third-party data has been compromised or misused as a result of the incident.  Independent cybersecurity experts have been retained to assist the Company in dealing with the matter in accordance with industry best practices. However, due to the nature of the cybersecurity incident, these efforts may or may not result in the recovery of some or all of the misappropriated funds.

The Company has notified the appropriate authorities including the Vancouver Police Department’s Financial Crimes Unit which has started an investigation. The Company is working with authorities in furtherance of their investigations as applicable.

The Company is also actively pursuing all available avenues to recover the misappropriated funds, including working with its financial institutions and exploring all legal remedies against parties that may be responsible for, or have facilitated, the fraudulent transactions. The Company is further assessing all applicable insurance coverage and potential recovery options. SANTERAMO IN COLLE, Bari, Italy--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Natuzzi S.p.A. (NYSE: NTZ) (“Natuzzi” or the “Company”), one of the most renowned brands in the production and distribution of design and luxury furniture, today announces that its ordinary and extraordinary shareholders’ meeting (the “Meeting”) was held on November 23, 2026, at the Company’s registered office in Santeramo in Colle (Bari), Italy, and approved all the items on the agenda, as described below.

Extraordinary Shareholders’ Meeting

Reserved Capital Increase. The Meeting approved a capital increase for consideration, in cash, on an indivisible basis, with the exclusion of pre-emptive rights pursuant to Article 2441, paragraph 5, of the Italian Civil Code, reserved for Invest 2003 S.r.l. (“INVEST”), for a total amount of EUR 17,499,998.73 (of which EUR 491,159.10 is allocated to share capital and EUR 17,008,839.63 to share premium) (the “Reserved Capital Increase”), through the issuance of 49,115,910 new ordinary shares at an issue price of EUR 0.3563 per share (approximately US$2.06 per American Depositary Share).

The new shares were paid up in full through the application of the equity reserve earmarked in favor of INVEST, resulting from the irrevocable reclassification of EUR 12.5 million and EUR 5 million of shareholder loans on March 31, 2026 and September 9, 2026, respectively, as capital contributions towards a future capital increase, without any further cash contribution. The new shares will have the same characteristics and dividend entitlement as the outstanding shares.

As previously disclosed, the Reserved Capital Increase forms part of the corporate steps being taken by the Company in connection with its request for review of the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”) delisting determination filed on September 10, 2026.

The Reserved Capital Increase was subscribed for in full by INVEST on November 26, 2026 and is fully paid up as of the date hereof, with only the related filing formalities with the competent Companies Register remaining outstanding.

Delegated Rights Issues. The Meeting granted the Board of Directors authority, pursuant to Article 2443 of the Italian Civil Code, to increase the share capital for consideration, in cash, on a divisible basis, on one or more occasions, by June 30, 2027, through two separate rights issues to be offered on a pre-emptive basis to those entitled thereto:

(a) up to a maximum amount of EUR 15,000,000, including share premium, to be offered to all shareholders on a pre-emptive basis and structured to allow minority shareholders, upon full subscription, to restore their percentage shareholdings prior to the Reserved Capital Increase, subject to INVEST’s prior waiver of its pre-emptive rights, described below (the “Delegated Rights Issue for Minorities”); and

(b) up to a maximum amount of EUR 65,000,000, including share premium, through the issuance of up to 1,300,000,000 ordinary shares, to be offered to all shareholders on a pre-emptive basis, with the Board of Directors determining the issue price, terms and timing (the “Delegated Rights Issue”).

As previously disclosed, the Delegated Rights Issue, contemplated by the compliance plan accepted by the NYSE, as announced by the Company on May 22, 2026, is intended to (i) strengthen the Company’s capital structure and enable it to regain compliance, before July 6, 2027, with the US$50,000,000 average global market capitalization or stockholders’ equity standard set out in Section 802.01B of the NYSE Listed Company Manual; and (ii) raise funds to support the Company’s cash flow performance and the successful outcome of the composizione negoziata della crisi (CNC) proceedings, as part of the restructuring process.

The Delegated Rights Issue and the Delegated Rights Issue for Minorities both presuppose the successful completion of the Reserved Capital Increase and are independent and non-alternative: the Board of Directors may exercise either or both of the authorities, depending on the Company’s capital strengthening needs, market conditions and the progress of the restructuring process.

In connection with the Delegated Rights Issue for Minorities, INVEST delivered to the Company a conditional and limited waiver, dated November 4, 2026, of the pre-emptive rights to which it would be entitled in the Delegated Rights Issue for Minorities (the “Waiver”). The Waiver is limited to the number of ordinary shares necessary to enable shareholders other than INVEST, in the event of full subscription, to restore their respective percentage shareholdings held immediately prior to the Reserved Capital Increase.

The Waiver’s effectiveness is subject to the satisfaction of the conditions precedent specified therein, including completion of the Reserved Capital Increase and issuance of the corresponding ordinary shares to INVEST. The Waiver requires that the Delegated Rights Issue for Minorities be resolved upon by the Board of Directors, subscribed for and paid up by June 30, 2027, without any automatic or unilateral extension, and does not extend to shares issued in excess of the applicable rebalancing limit.

The Waiver does not extend to the Delegated Rights Issue or to any other capital increase, and INVEST retains its pre-emptive and other rights in respect of such transactions. The Waiver does not constitute a commitment by INVEST to (i) subscribe for any additional ordinary shares, (ii) provide further funding to the Company or (iii) subscribe for any unsubscribed shares.

Elimination of Nominal Value. The Meeting approved the elimination of the indication of the nominal value of the Company’s ordinary shares, previously EUR 1.00 each, which according to Italian law constituted a minimum issue price for new shares, thereby providing flexibility in setting the issue price both for the Reserved Capital Increase and for any subsequent rights issues.

The resolutions adopted at the extraordinary session of the Meeting and described above will take effect upon their registration with the competent Companies Register, which the Company expects to occur in the coming days.

Ordinary Shareholders’ Meeting

Appointment of a Statutory Auditor. The Meeting appointed Mr. Vito Plantone as a standing member of the Board of Statutory Auditors, following the resignation of Mr. Francesco Campobasso. Mr. Plantone will remain in office until the expiration of the term of the current Board of Statutory Auditors, which will occur upon approval of the Company’s financial statements for the year ending December 31, 2027.

It matters to investors because that extra money becomes part of the company’s equity, strengthening the balance sheet without adding debt and signaling market interest; it can also be used for certain corporate actions such as buybacks or covering issuance costs.
equity reservefinancial
A portion of a company’s shareholders’ equity that is set aside for a specific purpose and not available for ordinary dividend payments. Equity reserves arise from transactions or accounting rules—examples include share premium from issuing stock above par, revaluation gains, legal or statutory reserves, and stock‑based compensation reserves—and act like a labeled bucket within owners’ equity that affects how much profit can be distributed and how ownership or book values are reported.
american depositary sharefinancial
An American Depositary Share (ADS) is a U.S.-listed certificate that represents a specified number of shares in a foreign company, held by a custodian bank; it works like a receipt that allows U.S. investors to buy and trade foreign equity on American exchanges without dealing with another country’s markets. Investors care because ADSs make foreign stocks easier to access, improve liquidity and settlement in dollars, and can affect dividend payments, voting rights and regulatory oversight compared with buying the underlying foreign shares directly.

Crews and customer support teams worked through the holiday in wind gusts up to 70 mph and heavy rain and continue restoration efforts across the Mid-Atlantic region.

CHICAGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--

Exelon and its operating companies mobilized employees, contractors and mutual-assistance resources during Thanksgiving as a powerful nor’easter brought damaging winds, heavy rain and coastal flooding to parts of the Mid-Atlantic, causing widespread damage and power outages.

The storm swept across the Mid-Atlantic, leaving hundreds of thousands of customers without service across BGE, PECO, Atlantic City Electric, Delmarva Power and Pepco territories. As of early Friday afternoon, the vast majority of those outages had been restored quickly and safely. Exelon continues to direct additional resources to the areas with the most severe damage to restore power to customers still without service.

"Our customers count on us every day, and that responsibility takes on a special meaning during the holidays, when families are gathering and communities are depending on us," said Mike Innocenzo, Exelon’s Chief Operating Officer. "Thousands of Exelon employees, contractors and partners have answered the call this holiday to safely restore power in the communities where they live and work. I want to thank them for being there for our customers and their neighbors when it matters most, and for staying on until the work is done."

Working around the clock for customers and their families

Across the Mid-Atlantic, crews from BGE, PECO, Atlantic City Electric, Delmarva Power and Pepco continue to work around the clock to restore power quickly and safely in some of the storm’s harshest conditions. Coastal wind gusts reached speeds as high as 70 mph in parts of New Jersey, Delaware and Maryland, while several inches of rain and flooding brought down trees, limbs, poles and wires and closed roads, limiting safe access to some of the hardest-hit areas. Exelon is moving resources to where they are needed most, including ComEd mutual assistance personnel and resources from the Chicagoland area that have traveled east to reinforce the hardest-hit communities.

Always on, with safety first

Throughout our service territories, dedicated employees work around the clock, preparing before storms, responding when conditions are at their worst and staying on the job until every customer is restored. Safety remains our top priority. Exelon and its utilities urge customers to stay away from downed wires and always assume they are energized. Customers should report outages and check their local utility's website or mobile app for the latest restoration information.

About Exelon

Exelon (Nasdaq: EXC) is a Fortune 200 company and one of the nation’s largest utility companies, serving almost 11 million customers through six fully regulated transmission and distribution utilities — Atlantic City Electric, BGE, ComEd, Delmarva Power, PECO, and Pepco. Exelon’s more than 20,000 employees dedicate their time and expertise to supporting our communities through reliable, affordable and efficient energy delivery, workforce development, equity, economic development and volunteerism.
